summary: The prepared base already contains the issue's exact two-line correction: both cache-aware tests pass the owned String from format! directly to BasicWorkerBuilder::new. Git history identifies commit 413df1f8db4fd159c5d07e960f9ec5547edeb5c1 as the change that removed both needless borrows. Reintroducing only those two borrows makes the documented Clippy command fail with exactly two needless_borrows_for_generic_args errors; restoring the base source makes the same command pass.

tests.command: cd sgl-model-gateway && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings (after temporarily reintroducing the two reported &format! expressions)
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression: Clippy 1.90 emitted exactly the reported needless_borrows_for_generic_args diagnostics at cache_aware.rs lines 682 and 741. Raw output: reports/j-71d48f3f7adc/raw/clippy-failing-before.log
Passing-after/current-base regression: the complete gateway CI lint command completed successfully with the owned String call sites. Raw output: reports/j-71d48f3f7adc/raw/clippy-passing-after.log
Independent behavior boundary for the first changed call site: one imbalanced-load random tie-break test ran and passed. Raw output: reports/j-71d48f3f7adc/raw/test-imbalanced-tie-break.log
Independent behavior boundary for the second changed call site: one cold-start random tie-break test ran and passed. Raw output: reports/j-71d48f3f7adc/raw/test-cold-start.log

gpu_execution.evidence: The defect and its validation are confined to Rust Clippy diagnostics and CPU unit tests; no model, accelerator kernel, or serving path is involved, so the assigned GPU was not used.

remaining_limitations: The prepared checkout starts after the historical fix, so the original a2e88279c tree was not used as the delivery base. Failing-before evidence was produced by reintroducing exactly the two historical borrows into the prepared implementation, and the repository history independently records the identical two-line removal in commit 413df1f8db4fd159c5d07e960f9ec5547edeb5c1.
No GPU or model-serving validation was performed because it cannot add evidence for this Rust-only lint issue.
